chapter_title_en: The Assembly of Ten Thousand Immortals
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 517: Ji Ning's New Swords & The Assembly of 10,000 Immortals
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning chooses the legendary nine-sword set, the Universal Salvation Sword of Ananda, in the War God Hall. Meanwhile, the Xia Emperor summons ten thousand Celestial Immortals for the Great Tribulation's final war! The scale of the conflict explodes in this pivotal Xianxia chapter.
og_title: The War Begins: Ji Ning's Ultimate Sword Formation & the Gathering Storm
og_description: A chapter of two halves: Ji Ning powers up with a legendary Buddhist sword set, only to find himself dwarfed by a gathering of ten thousand Celestial Immortals summoned for war.
twitter_title: Ji Ning levels up with a new sword formation, but the war is just beginning! 10,000 Celestial Immortals answer the call.
twitter_description: The Great Tribulation escalates as the Xia Emperor assembles a massive army. Ji Ning gets a deadly new set of flying swords and prepares for total war.

lore_anchors.definition: The highest trinity in the Daoist pantheon, reimagined in Desolate Era as a single supreme being whose three avatars are the Lords of Primordial Beginning, Numinous Treasure, and Dao and Virtue.
In Buddhist tradition, Gautama Buddha's chief attendant and cousin, famed for his perfect memory. In this novel, he is elevated to a Buddha-level creator of divine weapons.
A high-level spatial movement technique that allows a cultivator to instantly travel vast distances across the Three Realms, which can be locked by powerful formations.
A Ki Refiner who failed to transcend the Heavenly Tribulation but survived; they are immensely powerful but have limited lifespans and must endure increasingly deadly tribulations.
The political and spiritual center of the Grand Xia Dynasty; a massive, ancient city protected by supreme formations and home to the imperial palace.
The grand audience hall of the Grand Xia Imperial Palace, capable of seating many thousands of Immortals for major proclamations and assemblies.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning choose the Universal Salvation Sword of Ananda over the Three Pure Ones Swords?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Purely tactical math: nine swords in his formation will synergize far better and output more damage than three individual swords, even if the three are slightly stronger per unit.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are so many Celestial Immortals suddenly gathering at the capital?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Xia Emperor has declared a full mobilization for the Great Tribulation of the Three Realms, summoning every single Immortal in his territory for a war that threatens all existence.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the artifact spirit of the Universal Salvation Sword like?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The nine swords each have a spirit in the form of a golden-robed monk child. They are fiercely murderous and quizzed Ji Ning on his commitment to 'severing the world's sufferings,' to which he gave a suitably violent answer.
